So there's a slight inconsistency — the `/docs` path on the API (3001) returns 404, but the Swagger UI container is at 3002 and works (200). This is fine — the Swagger UI at 3002 is what's actually working and it's loading the API definition. The `/docs` path may not exist in this Laravel setup.
